entries.title: Psalms 127:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of Solomon.>> Unless Jehovah build the house, in vain do its builders labour in it; unless Jehovah keep the city, the keeper watcheth in vain:

entries.title: Psalms 127:2
segments: It is vain for you to rise up early, to lie down late, to eat the bread of sorrows: so to his beloved one he giveth sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 127:3
segments: Lo, children are an inheritance from Jehovah, [and] the fruit of the womb a reward.

entries.title: Psalms 127:4
segments: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

entries.title: Psalms 127:5
segments: Happy is the man that hath filled his quiver with them. They shall not be ashamed when they speak with enemies in the gate.
